# 6 greens remain, all in bottom row. Click them all.
remaining = [
    (32, 21), (32, 27), (32, 33), (32, 39), (32, 45), (32, 51)
]
actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in remaining]
result = action(actions)
print(f"Clicked {len(actions)} greens: game_over={result.get('game_over')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N'])
purs = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p' and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 60])
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
pp = None

    b = player[0]['boundary']
    pp = (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
print(f"After: greens={greens}, purples={purs}, player={pp}")

if greens == 0:
    print("ALL GREENS REMOVED!")
    # Check for target
    target = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'w']
    print(f"Targets (w): {len(target)}")
    for t in target:
        b = t['boundary']
        print(f"  at ({min(p[0] for p in b)}, {min(p[1] for p in b)})")
    
    # Check if level is done
    print(f"done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
